definitions.gloss: annex; annex building; secondary building; wing
definitions.explanation: A supplementary building that is separate from but belongs to the same institution as the main building. Used for hotels, museums, hospitals, and other facilities with multiple structures.

examples.japanese: お⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{別館|べっかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なります→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Your room is in the annex.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会議室|かいぎしつ}→会議室：01265_kaigishitsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{別館|べっかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧3⟦{階|かい}→階：01034_kai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The meeting room is on the third floor of the annex.

examples.japanese: {別館|べっかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{温泉|おんせん}→温泉：04117_onsen⟧⟦{付|つ}き→付き：26333_tsuki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{特別室|とくべつしつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The annex has special rooms with private hot springs.

notes:
A secondary building belonging to the same institution as the main building (⟦{本館|ほんかん}→本館：21133_honkan⟧). Very common at Japanese hotels, where the {別館|べっかん} may have a different character or price range from the main building.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {別館|べっかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧: annex room
- ⟦{本館|ほんかん}→本館：21133_honkan⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{別館|べっかん}: main building and annex
- {別館|べっかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{泊|と}まる→泊まる：10445_tomaru⟧: to stay in the annex

USAGE:
At Japanese inns (⟦{旅館|りょかん}→旅館：01049_ryokan⟧) and hotels, the {別館|べっかん} sometimes offers rooms at a different price point or with a different atmosphere from the ⟦{本館|ほんかん}→本館：21133_honkan⟧. It can be either more or less prestigious depending on the facility.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{本館|ほんかん}→本館：21133_honkan⟧: main building
- {新館|しんかん}: new building/wing
- {離|はな}れ: detached building — a smaller, separate structure, often more private and exclusive
